correctness.rationale: Every independent subset and every 205680 face incidence is exhaustively reconstructed from GP(12,5). A 17605-pair acyclic augmented Morse matching leaves 6 cells of dimension 5 and 3 of dimension 6. The exactly reproduced signed integer Morse boundary is rank 2 with a -1 determinant minor, hence two unit integral cancellations, and the remaining 6-cell is trivial. Since pi_5 of six 5-spheres is Z^6, integer degree vectors fully classify these attachments. Independent mod-2 chain ranks agree and do not substitute for the integral proof. Both complete standalone verifiers replay successfully.
